ArgonTest.Name: Static method owner token
ArgonTest.InputSource:
module _ import Argon.Core::*
def generic_identity(token T: type)(value: T): T = value
record GenericOwner(token T: type) public def static.identity(value: T): T = generic_identity T value public def static.method_identity(token U: type)(value: U): U = generic_identity U value end
proc main(): () do puts (GenericOwner(String).identity "owner token") puts (GenericOwner(String).method_identity String "method token") end
